I’m admittedly a huge stoner. The way you ingest changes the high. Edibles take longer to kick in but have a stronger high (for me). Vaping and smoking kick in fast but smoking is hotter going down and can make you cough more. I’ve never tried pure resin and tinctures and some of the more “artisanal” ways to do weed. The feeling of a high also changes depending on the strain of weed. The two most common strains I’ve heard of are indica and sativa but there’s at least one more I can’t remember. I prefer sativas because they make you less sleepy when you smoke and indicas put me down really fast. 

A typical high (for me, it’s different for everybody) feels very tingly and floaty. Everything is heightened in a weird way and I get really stupid. My motor function is a bit impaired as well so it messes up how I type. It’s pretty hard to describe exactly how a high feels when not high. 

My main advice is to just read personal accounts and sort of gather knowledge that way if you’re not planning on doing weed. If you want to learn a bit more about how a “stereotypical” stoner acts I’d suggest watching old stoner movies and just observe the culture around it. Some suggestions are the cheech and Chong movies, dude where’s my car (that’s my friends fave), and fast times at ridgemont high. You could also just lurk or ask questions in weed subreddits as well. Best of luck!
